rows.description: A better ORM for Go, based on non-empty interfaces and code generation.

Java ORM alternative to MyBatis & Hibernate: JPA-style CRUD + SQL-first queries. Dynamic conditions without <if> blocks; one SQL across 25 databases (auto dialect & function adaptation); self-optimizing pagination; cache translate (no dictionary JOINs); race-proof updateFetch ledgers; sharding, multi-tenancy, data masking. In production since 2008.
xorm是一个简单而强大的Go语言ORM库，通过它可以使数据库操作非常简便。本库是基于原版xorm的定制增强版本，为xorm提供类似ibatis的配置文件及动态SQL支持，支持AcitveRecord操作
